locator: I q.3 a.7 co.: manifestum est quod Deus nullo modo compositus est, sed est omnino simplex
interpretation: The conclusions of q.3 a.1 (not a body), a.2 (not matter and form), a.4 (essence is esse) and a.7 (in no way composite), gathered and read as being about the prima via's first mover.
